# `randn`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a random value with independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) values drawn from the standard normal distribution.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
randn([seed])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [0, 1] |
| Deterministic | no |

## Examples

```sql
-- randn, example 1
> SELECT randn();
-- the result differs on every run
```

```sql
-- randn, example 2
> SELECT randn(0);
-- the result differs on every run
```

```sql
-- randn, example 3
> SELECT randn(null);
-- the result differs on every run
```
